seeded.name: same-bar look-ahead: weights from close[t] applied to the return ending at t (no shift)
survivorship: universe is today's index membership applied to history
no transaction costs, slippage or turnover charge
lookback chosen on the full sample then reported as out-of-sample
shuffled KFold on overlapping 20-session forward labels without purge/embargo

decoys: load_prices (8-13), sharpe (39-44), max_drawdown (46-49) are intended correct; findings there count as out-of-range.
detection_rule: A seeded defect is detected in a run when at least one finding has a category in the defect's categories and a line inside one of its line_ranges. Findings matching no seeded defect are counted as out_of_range (not necessarily wrong).
prompt_control: You are reviewing a Python backtest for methodological defects that would make its reported results misleading. Read the file momentum_backtest.py (line-numbered below). Report every defect you find. Output ONLY a JSON array; each element is {"line": <int line number where the defect is most directly located>, "category": <one of CATEGORIES>, "explanation": <one sentence>}. Do not run any commands.
prompt_skill_prefix: Apply the following skill (SKILL.md and its references from tradermonty/claude-trading-skills backtest-expert at commit bc5515644c70abc90fbc20d15c838c47808ca893) to the task after it.
